backup.integrity: SHA-256 sidecar, pg_restore --list, distinct disposable database restore

backup.schedule: daily 03:17 UTC, randomized delay at most 15 minutes

financial_cost: 0 planned incremental paid services; same-VPS backup storage consumes at most 4 GiB; external disaster recovery not yet funded or configured

allow one-shot PIT V2 migration rerun and possible V2-only service recreation against preserved volume
create only PIT V2 backup database role, /opt/pit-v2-backup files, /var/backups/pit-v2 archives and PIT V2 systemd units
run one PIT V2 backup and distinct disposable restore, then enable PIT V2 timer

abort before mutation if any material state differs

rollback_detail.isolation_failure: stop only V2 API and worker immediately; preserve V2 and V1 volumes; no shared proxy change
